verdict.rationale: Stripe documents machine payments for exactly this case. Your server returns an HTTP 402 challenge, the agent presents a credential and retries, and Stripe settles to your balance, via MPP or x402 "without a checkout UI". The docs include a per-call pricing example ("charge 0.50 USD per API call"), an `mppx validate` conformance tool, documented per-rail minimums and fiat settlement with refunds. Runtime probes confirm the MPP spec is published and the mppx SDK resolves on npm. missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of a completed paid call, sub-cent micropayments (minimum is $0.01 for stablecoins and $0.50 for card SPTs), stablecoin availability in New York, fuller end-to-end documentation (one community comment calls the MPP docs sparse).
